# The Fix Shelf

> The Fix Shelf makes printable planners, workbooks and checklists for the parts of life that fall apart — health, habits, pets, weddings, family and work — plus Affinity DTF tools for print shops. Every product is a digital download, used the same day it's bought.

Site: https://rastarr.github.io/fixshelf/
Stores: https://payhip.com/TheFixShelf, https://cooneymartin.gumroad.com/

## Guides

- [Salary Negotiation Script](https://rastarr.github.io/fixshelf/salary-negotiation-script-guide.html): Word-for-word salary negotiation scripts: the offer-call ask, the email template, the three pushback replies, and the internal promotion variant. Adapt the fills, keep the structure.
- [Printable ADHD Weekly Reset](https://rastarr.github.io/fixshelf/printable-adhd-weekly-reset.html): A printable ADHD weekly reset routine: 6 steps, one anchor task per day, and a comeback page for when the week derails. Free to follow, printable version included.
- [Wedding Day Timeline Template](https://rastarr.github.io/fixshelf/wedding-day-timeline-template.html): Copy-ready wedding day timeline templates for 2pm, 3pm and 4pm ceremonies: when to start getting ready, photography buffers, and the five things that break a wedding schedule.
- [Menopause Symptom Tracker Printable](https://rastarr.github.io/fixshelf/menopause-symptom-tracker-printable.html): A printable menopause symptom tracker method: which symptoms to record, how to log them so your doctor can act, and a 90-day tracker with doctor-visit prep built in.
- [Puppy Training Schedule by Age](https://rastarr.github.io/fixshelf/puppy-training-schedule-by-age.html): A puppy training schedule by age: daily rhythms for 8–10 weeks, 3 months, 4–6 months and 6–12 months, with feeding, naps, potty timing and what to train at each stage.
- [Wedding Planning Checklist Printable](https://rastarr.github.io/fixshelf/wedding-planning-checklist-printable.html): A month-by-month wedding planning checklist you can print once and work through: what to book first, when to send invitations, and the budget lines everyone forgets.
- [Vegetable Garden Planner Printable](https://rastarr.github.io/fixshelf/vegetable-garden-planner-printable.html): How to plan a vegetable garden layout on paper: bed maps with sun tracking, a planting calendar built from your own frost date, and a season log that improves next year's plan.
- [How to Reset a Messed Up Sleep Schedule (Honest Timeline + Method)](https://rastarr.github.io/fixshelf/sleep-schedule-reset.html): A workable method to reset a messed up sleep schedule: fix the wake time first, morning light, small bedtime shifts, the all-nighter recovery day, and why weekends undo it.
- [ADHD Task Breakdown](https://rastarr.github.io/fixshelf/adhd-task-breakdown-sheet.html): "Break it into smaller tasks" fails ADHD brains because the steps stay invisible. The four-column breakdown method: smallest visible first move, what started looks like, and what happens after 5 minutes.
- [ADHD Morning Routine](https://rastarr.github.io/fixshelf/adhd-morning-routine-checklist.html): Why ADHD mornings fail (decisions before coffee) and the two-part fix: a 5-minute night-before setup plus a time-anchored morning checklist for work-day adults.
- [Best ADHD Daily Planner for Adults? Five Criteria That Actually Matter](https://rastarr.github.io/fixshelf/adhd-daily-planner-adults.html): How to pick an ADHD daily planner as an adult: five criteria that predict whether you'll still use it in March — startability, weekly reset, comeback path, cost of a missed day, printable vs app.
- [ADHD Brain Dump Template](https://rastarr.github.io/fixshelf/adhd-brain-dump-template.html): A brain dump method that works with ADHD: get everything out of your head in 5 minutes, sort into now / today / someday, and leave with a top 3 — no app required.
- [DTF Print Settings](https://rastarr.github.io/fixshelf/dtf-print-settings-checklist.html): The DTF print settings and checks to run before every film: file mirroring and transparency, ink density, powder coverage, cure, and heat press starting points.
- [Free ADHD Printable Planner](https://rastarr.github.io/fixshelf/free-adhd-printable-sampler.html): A genuinely free ADHD printable planner PDF: brain dump page, Sunday reset, comeback page and task breakdown sheet. Instant download, no email required, print what you need.
